All 78 Neper popup sheets, both scales (156 files), draw a menu: the fewest sampled pixels differing from the page colour below the caption is 2652 (the one row Admin menu); none is blank. Windows, Linux, Cupertino and Material sheets untouched: 20 other apps re-rendered byte identical.

the dfm accelerator marks are not drawn in Neper (the plain label)
